records.original_sql: SELECT * FROM example.order_echo(100) ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 2;
records.replacement_sql: SELECT * FROM example.order_echo(100) ORDER BY n DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2;
records.reason: DuckDB defaults DESC to NULLS LAST while DataFusion follows PostgreSQL-style NULLS FIRST; the explicit clause preserves the source corpus's intended null policy.
